description:
Get a link that opens registering an existing token on chaindaddy.io

For a token that already exists, launched anywhere: returns only a chaindaddy.io `url` that opens its registration, and a one-line `summary` of it. With `symbol` the link opens the token's own page with its registration ready; without it, Add a token, which indexes the token first. It creates, stores, pays and signs nothing: the person opens the link, signs in with the wallet that deployed or owns the token, and confirms in their own wallet on the page.

chain.description: The token's chain, as a key (base, ethereum, solana, ...) or chain id

tokenAddress.description: The token's contract address (EVM) or mint (Solana)

name: prepare_token_registration

summary.description: One line saying what the link opens

url.description: The chaindaddy.io page to open, filled in. Nothing has been created.

title: Prepare a token registration link
